title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Wine Tour with Tastings
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the rich flavors of Niagara's renowned wine country on this fully-guided wine tour. Led by an expert guide, enjoy tastings at four prestigious wineries, including a structured seminar on premium wines. Experience the charm of Niagara-on-the-Lake with 75-90 minutes to explore and dine at your leisure. This engaging tour is ideal for wine enthusiasts and casual drinkers alike, with opportunities to sample rare Icewine and gourmet cheese pairings.

- Fully-guided tour with knowledgeable wine industry professionals
- Visit 4 unique wineries and enjoy 12-16 tastings of award-winning wines
- Roundtrip transportation provided in executive mini buses for up to 14 passengers
- Explore the picturesque village of Niagara-on-the-Lake with ample free time
